userStories.title: Scanner: fetch OHLCV and price in ETH (token-native denomination)
userStories.description:
PRE-CONDITION: Run 'git checkout dev' before making any changes. Verify with 'git branch --show-current' -- must show 'dev'. All work stays on dev branch.

Current state: range_scanner.py exists at businesses/horizen-zkverify/range-trader/scripts/range_scanner.py. It fetches OHLCV candles with currency='usd' (line 179) and prices via DexScreener priceUsd / GeckoTerminal price_usd (lines 274, 289, 305). The scan_all() result dict has key 'price_usd'.

What to build: Change the scanner to use ETH denomination throughout.

1. In _fetch_gt_ohlcv(): change params={'limit': OHLCV_DAYS, 'currency': 'token'} so GeckoTerminal returns candles in the pool quote token (WETH). Note: for TOKEN/WETH pools, currency='token' returns price in WETH.

2. Add a new function get_price_eth(token_address: str) -> float that fetches the token price in ETH. Use DexScreener primary: GET https://api.dexscreener.com/latest/dex/tokens/{address}, filter pairs where chainId=='base', pick highest liquidity, return float(best['priceNative']). Fallback: GeckoTerminal token info endpoint, return float(attrs.get('price_usd', 0)) / eth_price_usd where eth_price_usd comes from a DexScreener lookup of WETH (0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006).

3. In scan_all(): call get_price_eth(address) and store as result['price_eth'] in addition to (or replacing) result['price_usd']. The S/R calc uses candles so it will now produce support/resistance in ETH automatically. Also update the __main__ print to show price_eth.

Constraints:
- Keep get_price() (USD) intact -- range_daily_summary.py uses it for wallet valuation
- Add sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent)) if not already present
- The OHLCV cache key must change to avoid serving stale USD candles -- append '_eth' to cache keys or clear the cache file on first run by checking currency marker
- Do not modify support_resistance.py

What to build: Change position sizing to use ETH balance instead of USDC.

- Keep the POSITION_SIZE_PCT name the same
